verdict.rationale: The pack documents a CLI, an organization Public API, a `bw serve` local REST API and an official MCP server, but no first-party documentation of an official SDK a developer can build against. The only SDK reference is a community aside about an 'SDK relicensing controversy', which shows no usable SDK capability. The CLI, REST API and MCP server are different integration surfaces, not SDKs, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
